publisher: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries
ownership: Official Washington contractor-license records published through the State of Washington open-data portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata and selected-field API queries
redistribution of aggregate counts with publisher attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing ACTIVE contractor-license status as independent proof of continuous operations, current compliance, public access, or an open storefront
representing a contractor-reported mailing address as a verified physical site, establishment, storefront, or worksite
representing source-reported business names as verified legal names
representing this license dataset as every business or contractor operating in Washington or the United States
retaining or exporting source phone-number or named-principal fields
inferring parent company, ownership, network affiliation, or cross-source identity without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries, L&I Contractor License Data - General, via Data.WA.gov.
retention: Retain immutable privacy-minimized selected-source and governed normalized releases unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Aggregate counts may be redistributed under the catalog PDDL terms with L&I attribution, exact refresh/checksum, and license/address limitations. Record-level normalized artifacts remain local-review-only because business names can identify people and mailing addresses can be residences.
personal_data_handling: The connector requests neither phonenumber nor primaryprincipalname. Business names can identify natural persons and mailing addresses can be residences, so normalized record-level artifacts remain local-review-only.
